associations.rationale: The type states only that every nilpotent ideal lies in the Jacobson radical; it does not also state that the radical is nilpotent and two-sided.
The type states only that the Jacobson radical is two-sided; it does not also state nilpotence and maximality among nilpotent ideals.
The type states only that the finite-dimensional algebra's Jacobson radical is nilpotent; it does not also state two-sidedness and containment of every nilpotent ideal.
